consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: improvement notice - critical safeguard at TX-3001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on TX-3001 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. TX-3001 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 19 December 2013 a regulatory notice was issued concerning TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following commissioning of replacement equipment.
